summary: A Georgia tower list names a Grady County lookout reno with an elevation of 269 (read as feet); no other source found describes a tower at that site.

facts.status_note: Only a tower list names this lookout. No source confirms that a tower stood or stands at the site.

evidence.supports: list entry for reno in Grady County at 269 (elevation column)
Reno is an unincorporated community in Grady County
evidence.quote: Reno is an unincorporated community in Grady County
A post office called Reno was established in 1911, and remained in operation until 1933.
The Georgia General Assembly incorporated Reno as a town in 1913.
The town's municipal charter was repealed in 1995.

notes_for_editor: Only one list names this tower, and the list has no notes, dates, owner or design. The 2026 searches found no Reno lookout in the Georgia Forest Lookouts index or in the Vanishing Georgia category pages. Two near matches are not this site: the Forest Lookouts index records a Grady County Forestry Commission tower at Hawthorne Trail, sold at auction in 2006, about 25 km north of this point; and a 2020 cultural survey concerns a Reno cell tower in Cairo, which is not a lookout. The list's 269 is read as feet, matching other entries. Wikipedia is used for the place only; a Grady County history source would help.
